content:
josh_product: quick sync — we need to lock the v1->v2 route deprecation cadence and what we ship in the migration docs. customer asks starting to pile up.

maria_pm: +1. main questions: timeline, whether we provide a compat shim/header, and what SDK support we guarantee.

sam_engineer: leaning toward a compatibility header that keeps v1 semantics for a defined window instead of an opaque redirect. easier for SDKs and avoids magic.

leah_eng: agree. an opt-in header like `X-Redwood-Compat: v1` would allow gradual rollouts and easier telemetry.

josh_product: proposed plan: 3-stage approach — (1) opt-in compat header + SDK flag, (2) automated fallback mapping for common params for 90 days, (3) hard deprecation after 180 days unless extended. thoughts?

maria_pm: seems reasonable. 180 days gives customers time, 90-day automatic fallback reduces breakage. need explicit launch criteria though: docs, SDKs, sample migrations, and support playbook.

sam_engineer: launch criteria checklist idea:
- docs: migration guide + quickstart + curl examples
- SDKs: patch release for js/py with compat flag
- infra: telemetry + deprecation warnings in logs
- rollout infra: canary + per-tenant opt-out
- support: email template + dedicated slack channel for early adopters

leah_eng: add a test harness for core customers (AcmeCorp, FinCo) — get them onto the canary in week 1.

nora_support: support burden concerns: if we keep fallback mapping, we need a triage FAQ for common failure modes. I'll draft the FAQ and email templates.

alex_sre: SRE notes: need to track error+latency deltas per route. plan to emit a `compat.migration.delta` metric and alerts if delta > 5% for 15m. also want an automated rollback knob in the router.

josh_product: good. operational rule: if rollback triggered, revert to v1 default for affected tenants and open a postmortem.

sam_engineer: rough dev tasks for eng:
- add header parsing and compat mapping middleware (sam)
- SDK flags and examples (sam/leah)
- telemetry hooks (leah)
- routing fallback and rollback (alex)
- docs + migration guide (maria + nora)

josh_product: timeline proposal: week 0: implement header + SDK flag; week 1: internal canary and 2-3 core customers; week 2-6: public beta with automated fallback enabled; week 7: start deprecation notices and switch to monitoring-only for mapping; week 26: hard deprecation (turn off fallback).

maria_pm: that aligns with our launch quarter. need to finalize copy for deprecation notices: first notice at 90 days before hard deprec; reminder at 30d and 7d.

leah_eng: small code example for the compat header (for docs):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-Compat: v1" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":100}'
```

sam_engineer: And SDK sample (py):

```python
client = Redwood(api_key=TOKEN, compat_mode="v1")
resp = client.chat.create(messages=[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])
```

josh_product: one open question: do we allow the compat header indefinitely for enterprise customers as a paid private support option?

maria_pm: reasonable to offer an extended compat contract for enterprise customers for a fee. legal/security signoff needed. add to sales enablement.

nora_support: we'll need an internal playbook and a dedicated support channel. recommend `#support-compat-migration` for the first 3 months.

alex_sre: also set a quota limit on compat mode per tenant for beta to avoid abuse. e.g., 1000 reqs/min default.

sam_engineer: one implementation note: mapping v1 function-calling params to v2 structured-output is non-trivial. recommend we ship mappings for the 80% case and document edge cases.

josh_product: decision check: do we proceed with 180-day hard deprecation + opt-in header + 90-day automated fallback? vote: :thumbsup: proceed, :thumbsdown: change.

maria_pm: :thumbsup:

sam_engineer: :thumbsup:

leah_eng: :thumbsup:

nora_support: :thumbsup:

alex_sre: :thumbsup:

josh_product: consensus. action items:
- sam: middleware + SDK patch (due in 7d)
- leah: telemetry + test harness (due in 7d)
- maria: docs + deprecation copy + customer comms (due in 10d)
- nora: support playbook + email templates (due in 10d)
- alex: metrics/alerts + rollback knob (due in 7d)

josh_product: i'll draft the public migration guide after your drafts are in. we'll run a short review Wednesday.

deploy-bot: canary deployed: compat-shim v1 -> v2 mapping (canary) to infra/canary-1 at 1860001500 :rocket:

maria_pm: thanks all — I'll schedule the review and ping the core customers. :calendar:

sam_engineer: added ticket RW-4523 for the compat middleware.

josh_product: closing thread — will post the migration checklist PR when ready. :white_check_mark:
